definition: The process keeps its shape. A paper or PDF artefact becomes a credential, and the sequence of steps does not change.
Steps, hand-offs or waiting are removed and the channel may change, but the process is recognisably the same one.
An existing process is reorganised around verifiable data. Roles, sequence or who holds what change, and the old process is not recoverable from the new one.
The activity was not viable before, because the trust it depends on could not be established at acceptable cost.
